SV-11756.summary: Duplicate-part merge tool can change past Inventory Value when one copy is untracked
SV-11756.note: No case: ships separately, Chris Ward 26 Oct 2026. The duplicate-part merge tool is a console command an operator runs (app:inventory:delete-duplicate-part, SV-10939); no screen runs it, so a manual tester cannot reach the behaviour. Chris Ward, 26 Oct 2026: Parts Lifecycle ships without the fix and the tool is not to be run where the two copies have different tracking. Developers' check (its own acceptance: tracked 5/$50 + untracked 3/$30 leaves $50 in both directions; app and SQL agree). Related manual coverage that stays: past-date Inventory Value leaves out untracked parts (S5-14, ACC-3) and saved past figures are kept (IV-11, ACC-4).
